title: English Opening
intro: 1.c4 grabs the d5 square from the side. Against 1...e5 it is like a Sicilian with colours reversed and an extra move for White.

lessons.title: The King's English
lessons.summary: c4, Nc3, g3 and Bg2: pressure on d5 and the long diagonal.

steps.text: 1.c4 controls d5 without putting a pawn in the centre yet. White's plan: Nc3 and a bishop on g2, all aiming at d5 and the long light diagonal.
If Black takes the centre with ...d5, White swaps it off with cxd5 and the bishop on g2 rakes the long diagonal towards b7 and a8.
Set up the English as White.
steps.hint: c4, Nc3, g3, then take on d5 and put the bishop on g2.
steps.ifWrong: Follow the plan: c4, Nc3, g3, cxd5, Bg2.
steps.ifRight: The bishop on g2 already hits the knight on d5 and the queenside.

steps.text: Black steps away from the diagonal with 5...Nb6.
Develop your king's knight and control the centre.
steps.hint: Bring the knight to f3, attacking e5.
steps.ifWrong: Play 6.Nf3 to hit e5 and prepare castling.
steps.ifRight: Now e5 is under attack and White is ready to castle.

steps.ifWrong: Play 7.O-O so your rook can enter the game on the c-file or e-file.
steps.ifRight: Next come d3, Be3 and Rc1, pressing down the c-file.

lessons.title: The queenside expansion
lessons.summary: Use Rb1 and b4 to push on the flank where you have extra space.

steps.text: In closed English structures, White's pawn on c4 and bishop on g2 point at the queenside. White expands on that side with Rb1 and b4.
Prepare the b4 advance with your rook.
steps.hint: Put your a1 rook behind the b-pawn.
steps.ifWrong: Play 8.Rb1 so b4 is supported by both the a-pawn and the rook.
steps.ifRight: Rb1 also steps off the long h8-a1 diagonal.

feedback.b2b4: 8.b4 loses a pawn to 8...Nxb4. Support it first with 8.Rb1.

steps.text: Black tries to slow down your plan with 8...a5.
Give b4 extra support with a pawn move.
steps.ifWrong: Play 9.a3 so you can still push b4 next.

steps.text: Black brings a rook towards the centre with 9...Re8.

steps.ifWrong: Play 10.b4 to gain space and open lines on the queenside.
steps.ifRight: If Black takes on b4, axb4 opens the a-file and keeps strong pressure.

steps.text: Black took on b4 with 10...axb4. Recapture and open a file for your pieces.
steps.ifWrong: Play 11.axb4 to open the a-file and drive Black's pieces back with b5.
steps.ifRight: The a-file is open, and b5 is a strong follow-up.
